# Vocabahn

German vocabulary learning app: a shared AI-enriched dictionary, FSRS spaced-repetition flashcards, and curated courses — built as a mobile-first PWA.

## About this Project
Vocabahn pairs a community-shared German dictionary, enriched on demand by an LLM, with FSRS spaced-repetition flashcards and CEFR-aligned courses. A derived per-user knowledge model graduates words out of study automatically. Micro-stories retell real German news articles, on subjects the learner picks, at their CEFR level and around their current words — one is written for each learner every morning in their own timezone. Reading records which words didn't land. An opt-in Web Push reminder brings learners back at a time they choose, in their own timezone. Production drills and a session planner are described in `docs/legacy/prd.md` but are not implemented.

## Tech Stack
- Backend: NestJS 11, Prisma, PostgreSQL, Redis, BullMQ (queue worker runs inside the API process — there is no separate worker app)
- Frontend: React 19, Vite, Tailwind CSS 4, TanStack Query, GSAP + Motion
- Shared: Zod schemas (`packages/shared/`)

Read `docs/system/README.md` before editing code, then `.agents/AGENTS.md` for development rules regarding safety, architecture, and UI/UX conventions.
